_note: Evergreen explainer topics: one free / open-source AI tool each. 'repo' is the GitHub project and its README is the source text the script is grounded in; topics without a repo use 'url' (a page whose text is the source). Add freely; used ones are skipped via data/topics_history.json. Order matters: the next unused topic is picked from the top, so tools people search for most go first. Tool topics (repo) and how-it-works topics (kind: concept, url + source_url) alternate.
